newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-ITALY-BOSNIA TO PLAY FRIENDLY IN SARAJEVO.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ITALY-BOSNIA TO PLAY FRIENDLY IN SARAJEVO.

text.p: Italy have agreed to play a soccer friendly against Bosnia in Sarajevo next month, a spokesman for the Italian soccer federation said on Thursday.
The spokesman said a date for the match had not yet been confirmed but Italy's sports daily Corriere dello Sport said it would be held on November 6.
Italy will be the first national team to play in Sarajevo since the end of the Bosnian conflict.
After successfully staging an international athletics meeting last month in the Kosevo stadium, Bosnia had sought to play their home World Cup qualifying matches there.

However FIFA, soccer's world governing body, ruled that their home matches should be held at the neutral venue of Bologna, Italy. Bosnia played a first qualifying match against Croatia in Bologna on Tuesday and were defeated 4-1.
The federation spokesman said he could not confirm a report in Corriere dello Sport that Deputy Prime Minister Walter Veltroni would accompany the Italian squad to Sarajevo.
